name: PR Timeline renders the seeded commit row in accent blue
description: From PR #482's Agent runs tab, the Timeline interleaves agent runs with the PR's commits. The seeded commit (a1b2c3d4e5f6 'Add token-bucket rate limiter') must render as a commit row: git-commit icon + short sha, with the sha carrying the accent (blue) colour token that distinguishes commits from run rows. The colour is asserted as the TOKEN on the inline style attribute (color:var(--accent)) rather than a computed rgb: the computed value differs per theme (#3b82f6 dark / #2563eb light), so a computed-colour assertion would silently pin this flow to whichever theme the browser profile happens to carry. NOTE — the Timeline's copy-shareable-link button is deliberately NOT covered here: seed.ts writes no agent_runs rows (the seeded review carries no run_id), so PR #482's Timeline has commit rows only and no run row exists to copy a link from. Creating one would require an actual review run, i.e. a live model call, which every flow here is forbidden from doing; that button's click → icon swap is covered by RunHistory.test.tsx instead. Read-only seeded data. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB (hermetic stack).
